document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: I am writing to report a problem with rubbish being dumped on the land beside Mill Lane, near the entrance to Hawthorn Woods.

Over the past two months, someone has repeatedly left large amounts of rubbish there, including old furniture, building materials and bags of household waste. It seems to happen late at night, as the piles are always there when I walk my dog early in the morning.

This is causing serious problems for local residents. The area now smells unpleasant, especially in warm weather, and I have seen rats near the piles on several occasions. Moreover, some of the building materials contain sharp metal, which could injure children who play in the woods.

I would therefore ask the council to remove the rubbish as soon as possible. I would also suggest installing a security camera and a sign warning that illegal dumping will result in a fine, as this might discourage the people responsible.
I would be grateful if you could inform me of the action that the council intends to take.

note.en: Here as = because: how the writer knows it happens at night.
note.kk: Мұнда as = because: неге түнде болатыны белгілі.
note.ru: Здесь as = because: почему понятно, что это ночью.

strengths.en: What, when and how often — easy for the council to check and act on.
strengths.kk: Не, қашан, қаншалықты жиі — кеңеске тексеру және әрекет ету оңай.
strengths.ru: Что, когда, как часто — совету легко проверить и действовать.
strengths.example: Over the past two months, someone has repeatedly left large amounts of rubbish there

strengths.en: From smell to rats to danger for children: the strongest point comes last, with “Moreover”.
strengths.kk: Иістен егеуқұйрыққа және балаларға қауіпке дейін — ең күшті дәлел соңында, «Moreover» арқылы.
strengths.ru: От запаха к крысам и к опасности для детей — самый сильный довод в конце, через «Moreover».
strengths.example: which could injure children who play in the woods

strengths.en: Clear up and prevent: the writer thinks beyond today.
strengths.kk: Тазалау және алдын алу — жазушы тек бүгінгі күнді ойламайды.
strengths.ru: Убрать и предотвратить — пишущий думает не только о сегодняшнем дне.
strengths.example: installing a security camera and a sign

strengths.en: No contractions and a polite request at the end.
strengths.ru: Нет сокращений, вежливая просьба в конце.
strengths.example: I would be grateful if you could inform me

note.en: The council, no name: formal — “Dear Sir or Madam”.
note.kk: Кеңес, аты жоқ — formal және «Dear Sir or Madam».
note.ru: Совет, имени нет — formal и «Dear Sir or Madam».

note.en: What the problem is and exactly where, in the first sentence.
note.kk: Мәселе не және дәл қай жерде — бірінші сөйлемде.
note.ru: Что за проблема и где именно — в первой фразе.

note.en: Bullet 1: what is dumped, how often and when — observations, not guesses.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — не тастайды, қаншалықты жиі және қашан: болжам емес, байқаулар.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — что выбрасывают, как часто и когда: наблюдения, а не догадки.

note.en: Bullet 2: effects in rising order — smell, rats, danger to children.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — өсу ретімен салдары: иіс, егеуқұйрықтар, балаларға қауіп.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — последствия по нарастающей: запах, крысы, опасность для детей.

note.en: Bullet 3: two measures — clear it now and prevent it in future.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — екі шара: қазір тазалау және болашақта алдын алу.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — две меры: убрать сейчас и предотвратить в будущем.

note.en: A polite request to be told what action will be taken.
note.kk: Қабылданған шаралар туралы хабарлауды сыпайы сұрау.
note.ru: Вежливая просьба сообщить о принятых мерах.

document.title: Reporting illegal dumping
bullets: explain how it is affecting local people
say what action you would like the council to take
document.question:

Write a letter to the local council. In your letter
